item.title: dotnet: Bring Your Own Model to the GitHub Copilot SDK with C#
item.description:
The GitHub Copilot SDK now supports BYOK, allowing apps to keep the agent runtime while routing model requests to a user-managed Microsoft Foundry or Azure OpenAI deployment. The post provides the full C# setup for this configuration.

  • Source: .NET

item.title: github: GitHub Models is now retired
item.description:
GitHub Models was retired on July 30, 2026. The playground, model catalog, inference API, and bring-your-own-key (BYOK) access are no longer available to customers.

  • Source: GitHub
